title: Discovery 1 — where the Hub contracts live (no credentials)
description: The natural first call against an unknown CBWeb3 network. Registered on every gateway regardless of which AMM services are wired, and unauthenticated because the addresses are public on-chain.
notes: Gateway: any. Twelve /api/v2 operations in this contract are fully public; this is the entry point of a zero-onboarding tutorial. Note the values are read from ONE gateway's environment, so this reports a deployment, not network state.
